comment: Official timetables compared with SalahTimes. fetch.py reads the fetch blocks; OfficialTimetableTests.swift reads the rest. Times in every CSV are local wall-clock times in timeZone.

sources.authority: Presidency of Religious Affairs of Turkey (Diyanet)
sources.coordinatesNote: Diyanet doesn't publish the reference point of a province's timetable. These are the usual coordinates of Istanbul's historic centre (Fatih).
sources.license: Diyanet's site states no licence for reuse; all rights reserved by default. Not redistributed.
